topics.title_zh: OpenAI放弃对华芯片封锁主张，押注GPT-6逆袭重构COBOL金融遗留代码
topics.title_en: OpenAI Softens China Chip Export Stance as GPT-6 Targets Legacy COBOL Systems
topics.summary_zh: 知情人士曝出OpenAI撤回对华严格芯片出口管制游说，既缓解与英伟达裂痕又靠拢特朗普政见；同时其披露GPT-6 Astra在MultiLangBench上以87.4%通过率攻克COBOL/Fortran等金融命脉基建，商业与政治双线变轨引发轩然大波。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI reportedly abandoned its push for strict AI chip export curbs to China, aligning with Nvidia and Trump. Simultaneously, OpenAI revealed GPT-6 Astra achieved an 87.4% MultiLangBench pass rate on legacy languages like COBOL and Fortran, pivoting toward enterprise legacy modernization and geopolitical pragmatism.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 企业级软件架构师与华尔街游说力量
perspective_pro.point_zh: 全球数万亿行COBOL支撑核心金融系统，AI攻破遗留栈将释放海量降本红利；在硬件封锁上松绑则保障了全球芯片供应链的确定性与产能采购优势。
perspective_pro.point_en: Automating trillions of lines of COBOL unlocks vast enterprise value, while easing chip export lobbying protects GPU supply chains and ensures commercial alignment.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 国家安全智库与系统容错专家
perspective_con.point_zh: 用黑盒LLM迁移缺乏文档的关键金融底层代码极易引入隐藏竞态缺陷，而地缘游说立场的剧烈摇摆暴露了头部实验室为算力利益妥协国家安全的短视。
perspective_con.point_en: Refactoring opaque legacy infrastructure via probabilistic LLMs risks systemic financial fragility, while flip-flopping on export curbs suggests pure commercial opportunism.

topics.title_zh: Mistral连发Voxtral 3全栈套件与LiveKit SDK，硬刚端侧本地推断浪潮
topics.title_en: Mistral Drops Voxtral 3 Voice Suite and LiveKit SDK Against Local Inference Wave
topics.summary_zh: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch高调发布覆盖35+语言与50+方言的Voxtral 3全栈语音套件，结合LiveKit推出包含推理调用的Voice Agent SDK；而Perplexity同日宣布Perplexity Computer实现全本地Mac端零WiFi运行，云端语音Agent与终端本地智能爆发路线之争。
topics.summary_en: Mistral launched its Voxtral 3 voice family alongside a LiveKit-powered Voice Agent SDK for multi-dialect real-time reasoning. Concurrently, Perplexity announced fully local offline inference on Macs, triggering intense debate between server-grade voice agent pipelines and zero-latency on-device processing.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 欧洲开源阵营与实时语音架构师
perspective_pro.speaker_en: European AI Champions & Voice Infra Engineers
perspective_pro.point_zh: 自然语音是下一代人机界面的终极入口，结合LiveKit的端到端推理闭环让Agent具备真实业务交互能力，远优于单向TTS拼接与单机计算限制。
perspective_pro.point_en: Voice is the definitive interface for agents. Integrating real-time listening, reasoning, and tool-calling unlocks robust human-level services beyond local device bounds.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 本地端侧极客与隐私安全研究员
perspective_con.point_zh: 云端全双工实时监听引发灾难性隐私与带宽成本危机，且依赖网络延迟无法胜任关键高频控制，本地离线算力才是用户与企业的唯一自主底线。
perspective_con.point_en: Continuous cloud-streamed audio invites catastrophic privacy risks and recurring bandwidth bills. Offline local inference remains the only viable path for trust and zero-latency execution.

topics.category_tag_en: AI Drug Discovery & De Novo Biology
topics.title_zh: Claude零样本设计蝎毒结合蛋白破局，Anthropic公开211份湿实验数据
topics.title_en: Anthropic Claude Designs De Novo Scorpion Neurotoxin Binders, Open-Sourcing Lab Data
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic联合Citrini展示重大前沿探索，利用大语言模型Claude从零设计结合5种致死性蝎毒神经毒素的蛋白质，并在湿实验中实证211个候选设计中有17个成功结合。官方开源全部湿实验数据与设计结构，引发生成式模型跨界颠覆结构生物学的狂潮与质疑。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic revealed that Claude successfully designed de novo protein binders targeting five deadly scorpion neurotoxins, confirming 17 successful binders out of 211 tested in wet labs. By open-sourcing all structural and experimental data, Anthropic triggered debate over LLM hallucinations versus biological physics-based design.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 计算生物学家与Anthropic前沿科研团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: 8%的湿实验实测结合命中率打破传统高通量筛选瓶颈，证明通用大模型已掌握高维生物大分子序列-结构映射语法，为罕见毒素解药研发开辟百倍加速路径。
perspective_pro.point_en: An 8% in vitro hit rate on zero-shot de novo binders proves frontier LLMs comprehend biophysical grammar, exponentially accelerating therapeutic binder discovery for neglected toxins.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 结构生物学家与药物毒理学学者
perspective_con.point_zh: 体外亲和力结合（Binder）距离真实在体抗毒素（Antivenom）有天壤之别，缺乏体内动力学与免疫原性验证，借机夸大LLM解决未解生物学问题属于公关炒作。
perspective_con.point_en: A raw binder is not an active antivenom. Without in vivo kinetic validation and immunogenicity profiles, branding preliminary binding hits as therapeutic triumphs is premature PR hype.
